description: Estación de Transferencia de Residuos Sólidos Urbanos is a dataset listed in City of Montevideo open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by División Limpieza. La Estación de Transferencia de Residuos, ubicada en Ruta 102 y Cno Manuel M. Fortet, funciona como punto intermedio para la descarga de residuos entre circuitos de la zona oeste, los que posteriormente son trasladados al Sitio de Disposición Final de Residuos. Coverage: Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher División Limpieza. Its tags are ambiente, limpieza, residuos sólidos. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is dag-uy. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mvd-portal.
